title: Linear recovery for equivariant section transformations
statement:
theorem equivariantModulePresheaf_recoverLinear
    {V : Scheme.{u}} (ℓ : ℕ) {P : Type u} [Group P] [Finite P]
    (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} P) V) [ConnectedSpace c.P]
    (N N' : Rep.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ) P)
    (η : c.equivariantModulePresheaf ℓ N ⟶ c.equivariantModulePresheaf ℓ N') :
    ∃! f : N.V →ₗ[ZMod ℓ] N'.V,
      ∀ (W : V.Etale) (s : c.equivariantSections ℓ N W) (x : c.sectionSpace W),
        (η.app (op W) s).val x = f (s.val x)

proof.text: Recover the unique linear map from eta on the diagonal of the torsor object.

Apply the naturality/open-fibre propagation statement to obtain the pointwise formula on arbitrary etale objects. Any other map with this global formula has the diagonal formula at the torsor object, so diagonal uniqueness gives equality.
